name: Tianzhen Z1
summary: Tianzhen Z1 is TLIBOT’s full-size bipedal humanoid robot. Its modular skeleton supports customized exterior designs and adaptations for different industries. The manufacturer emphasizes expressive upper-body motion through articulated neck, waist and shoulders, including shrugging and humanlike interaction. The official WRC 2026 product page establishes this named generation; current serial production and delivery terms are not verified.
